items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 47:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the seven lights of the expansion of Bina in ZA? When ZA attains the Mochin of Chaya, which come from the upper Aba and Ima, then he has complete Mochin, which spread in all his ten Sefirot, namely also to the new NHY. And then it is discerned that the Mochin spread in him up to the last Hod, which are seven Sefirot: KHB HGT NHY. And not like the Mochin of the Neshama, which did not spread in him except only up to the first Hod. See above, Answer 33. And the aspect of Tifferet and Yesod, which are the middle line, are not in the count, for then the Yesod of Ima ends in the Daat within him. (Item 45).
